text:
maria: Hey team, need to open quota + capacity reservation requests for two Azure subscriptions. Target regions: westeurope and northeurope. We need ND40rs and NC24rs (mix of NDv4 and NCv3) across sub-accounts 'prod-ai' and 'infra-pool'. Also hit NSG ephemeral port limits on a few VNets — will need port quota bump. Opening tracking ticket with Azure but want internal alignment.

sam: Thanks — do we have exact SKU counts and timeline?

maria: Planning for 12 x ND40rs (prod-ai, westeurope) and 8 x NC24rs (infra-pool, northeurope). Target ready-by date 2023-09-15 for prod ramp, but can phase: 6 ND first week. Need quota increases + capacity reservation (not just quota).

lucas: For reservations do we want explicit reservation resource or just capacity reservation via Azure Support? I can start the capacity-reservation request but will need subscription IDs and tenants.

maria: Use subs: sub-prod-01 and sub-infra-02 (I DMed the IDs). Also include request to lift regional vNet outbound ephemeral port limits (SNAT) — we saw failures on scale tests. Ticket should reference load test logs.

irene: Cost check: running pro-rata numbers, 12 ND40rs on dedicated reservation looks like ~€45k/month raw. Can we try a hybrid (some ND, some cheaper NC) to hit latency SLOs?\

maria: Agreed — mixed pool is fine. We specifically want ND for the very low-latency realtime shard, NC for batch/async. We'll plan A/B routing in SmartRouter.

sam: I started a spreadsheet (link: https://redwood.internal/sheets/az-gpu-capacity) with owners, subs, SKUs, and justification. Assigning lucas as PM, irene for cost signoff, and me for ticket escalation.

azure-support-bot: [AZ SUPPORT] Created support request AZ-202309-77321: "Quota and capacity reservation for ND/NC GPUs + SNAT port increase". ETA initial review: 24-48h. Please add subscription IDs in the portal and attach the workload runbook.

lucas: Added the subs and runbook to the portal. Attached scale-test logs (snippets below).

```
0:00:12 ERROR connection pool exhausted: SNAT ports used 65530/65536
0:00:13 WARN retrying request
0:00:20 ERROR job failed: ephemeral port exhaustion
```

irene: Pushed a cost estimate to the sheet and flagged financing for approval. Also put a note: consider Reserved Instance (1yr) if we commit to baseline 8 ND capacity after trial.

sam: Azure asked for justification per region and failover plan. I posted a short justification: "Customer-facing inference endpoints require <10ms p95 token latency; ND used for realtime shards, NC for training/batch failover." Adding that to ticket AZ-202309-77321.

maria: Quick checklist: 1) Azure ticket created (AZ-202309-77321) 2) Sub IDs attached 3) Runbook + logs attached 4) Cost signoff pending 5) Plan for staged reservation (6 ND first) 6) NSG/SNAT port increase requested. Anything else?

lucas: We should also request temporary burst capacity in near region (eastus2) as fallback for first 48h after launch — Azure can provide cross-region spare in emergency. I'll add that as a follow-up note in the ticket.

oncall-bot: Incident FYI: scheduled test window 2023-09-10 02:00-05:00 UTC for capacity smoke tests.

maria: Great. I'll wait for Azure reply then update the spreadsheet and our infra runbook with rollout playbook. If anyone wants to own the follow-up with Azure PM, volunteer here. :hand_up: 

sam: I'll take escalation follow-up if initial response stalls.

maria: Thanks all — will update thread when AZ support moves to 'in progress'. :thumbsup:
